name: GRLab.areal_invariant_const
statement:
theorem areal_invariant_const {f f₁ : ℝ → ℝ} {s : Set ℝ} (hs : Convex ℝ s)
    (hd : ∀ r ∈ s, HasDerivAt f (f₁ r) r)
    (hz : ∀ r ∈ s, 1 - f r - r * f₁ r = 0) :
    ∀ r ∈ s, ∀ r' ∈ s, r * f r - r = r' * f r' - r'

name: GRLab.areal_vacuum_of_mass
statement:
theorem areal_vacuum_of_mass (M : ℝ) {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    1 - (1 - 2 * M / r) - r * (2 * M / r ^ 2) = 0

name: GRLab.exists_mass_of_areal_vacuum
statement:
theorem exists_mass_of_areal_vacuum {f f₁ : ℝ → ℝ} {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b)
    (hd : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt f (f₁ r) r)
    (hz : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo a b, 1 - f r - r * f₁ r = 0)
    (h0 : ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo a b, r ≠ 0) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo a b, f r = 1 - 2 * M / r

name: GRLab.coordLine_eq_add_smul

name: GRLab.pderiv_add
statement:
lemma pderiv_add {b : Fin n} {F G : (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ} {x : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hF : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t : ℝ => F (coordLine x b t)) (x b))
    (hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t : ℝ => G (coordLine x b t)) (x b)) :
    pderiv b (fun y => F y + G y) x = pderiv b F x + pderiv b G x

name: GRLab.pderiv_const_mul

    pderiv b (fun y => c * F y) x = c * pderiv b F x

name: GRLab.pderiv_coord
statement:
lemma pderiv_coord (b c : Fin n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) :
    pderiv b (fun y => y c) x = if c = b then 1 else 0

GRLab.trace_einstein
statement:
theorem trace_einstein {g : MetricFn n} (hg : IsSymmetricMetric g) {x : Fin n → ℝ}
